title: fix(app-shell): Studio and Setup read an item's layered view at the package that owns it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb82Mq5gcFN1orxHSNuMYtEg)_

Fixes #28584

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 与 Setup 里读条目分层视图(`GET /meta/:type/:name/layers`)的调用,现在都带上调用方本来就知道的所属包(`?package=`):Studio 各柱所在的包、权限矩阵的包门(`packageId`)、或编辑页 URL 上的 `?package=`。实在不知道所属包时仍不带包,服务端的 409 拒绝原句作为加载错误显示;权限矩阵不再把这个 409 当成「没有这个权限集」。客户端不猜持有方。
- **为什么改**：#28337(PR #28583)之后,同名条目被两个包持有时,不带包的分层读取会被 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` 拒绝。Studio 的列表视图检查器、Interfaces 的 app 与叶子、Data 的对象、Automations 的流程、包 OWD 总览、权限矩阵、嵌入条目编辑器,以及条目页的重置/发布/丢弃后的重读,都还在不带包地读,在这种部署上会加载失败或误判。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `ui/packages/app-shell` 的 6 个源文件(只是给已有的读取补第三个参数,外加权限矩阵对 409 的一处改判)和测试;服务端与 spec 零改动。只读基座上带基座包读,服务端按 ADR-0146 D8 返回其声明的 `.custom` 覆盖。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的 `layeredPackageId` 与 `readLayered` 的 `.catch`(唯一改变错误处理的地方);再看 `views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` 的 `layeredAt`。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.twoHolders-28584.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.twoHolders-28584.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.twoHolders-28584.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572.test.tsx`,应 4 个文件 20 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无,席位落地。

## What changes

Each package-less `client.layered(...)` caller in `ui/packages/app-shell` now names the package it already reads and saves at:

- **List-view inspector** (`useObjectListViewDraft`): the published layer, and the copilot-marks read beside a draft, at the hook's `packageId`. On a read-only base that is the base, whose read serves its declared override (ADR-0146 D8, `servedOverlayRowCandidates`' `servedOverride`).
- **Interfaces pillar**: the app's baseline at `packageId`. The leaf's baseline, and the dashboard's published-layer read for served titles, at the leaf's owner: `current.addedIn` for an item the customization pair adds (#28572), else `packageId` (the effect now depends on `leafPackageId`).
- **Data pillar**: the object's layers at the item-level `packageId` (`current.addedIn ?? railPackageId` since #28572). **Automations pillar**: the flow's at `draftPackageId`, and none when the pillar has no package.
- **Package OWD overview**: `readObjectBodies` takes the panel's `packageId`.
- **Permission matrix**: `layeredPackageId` is the door's `packageId`, else the edit URL's `?package=` (`all`, the list's every-package scope, is not a package). The load, the package door's pre-save re-read and the environment door's post-save re-read all read there. With no owner known, a `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` from the load's read is rethrown to the load's error strip, which shows the server's sentence, instead of being caught to `null` ("no set known").
- **Embedded item editor**: the parent's layers at the hosting edit page's `?package=` (read when the save runs, as that page's own save binding is).
- **Item page** (`ResourceEditPage`): the load already passed `ownerPackageId`; the reset, publish and discard re-reads passed only the member, and now pass the same scope as the load.

Unchanged: `StudioItemTools` (every mount passes the pillar's `packageId`) and `StudioCustomizeControls` (reads at the base) already named a package. `usePublishAllDrafts`' `holdsNoPublishedLayer` (new on main, #28783) reads only drafts that carry no package, so no owner is known; it already takes any refusal as "holds a layer", never as "no artifact", and writes no navigation entry for it. Where no owner is known (an item page with no `?package=`, an Automations pillar with no package, the embedded editor with none), the read still names none and every one of those callers already shows a thrown refusal's message as its error.

## Tests

- `ObjectListViewInspector.twoHolders-28584.test.tsx` (new, 2): the real hook over a real `MetadataClient`, a server holding the view in two packages (the holder's stack with `?package=`, the 409 without). Open in each package: the one layered read names it, nothing is refused, the buffer holds that holder's view.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.twoHolders-28584.test.tsx` (new, 3): the package door reads its own package's stack and shows its grants; the routed page reads the URL's owner and shows that holder's grants; with `?package=all` the read names no package and the server's refusal sentence is shown, with no matrix rows.
- `StudioDesignSurface.twoHolders-28584.test.tsx` (new, 3): Interfaces (app and dashboard leaf, this package's nav), Automations (flow) and Data (object), each read at this package, none refused.
- `StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572.test.tsx` (+2): on a read-only base, the pair's own object (Data) and dashboard (Interfaces) read their layers at the pair.
- `StudioDesignSurface.railLabels.test.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.navDeepLink-11153.test.tsx`: the exact-argument assertion on the app's layered read now includes `{ packageId: PKG }`.

<details><summary>Reverse verification</summary>

- The three source files (`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) restored to `origin/main` with the new tests in place: 3 files, 8 of 8 failed. Restored to HEAD (`git diff HEAD` empty): 8 of 8 passed.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, deleting the permission matrix's rethrow line: 1 failed (the no-owner case), 2 passed; restored, blob equal to HEAD.
- The Interfaces leaf's two reads put back to `{ packageId }` (the base) after the main merge: `oneSurface-28572` 2 of 12 failed (the new dashboard case, and #28572's "an added item opens writable", whose save went to the base); restored, 12 of 12 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The embedded item editor's draft read and save, and the OWD overview's draft read, still name no package (card scope is the layered read). A package-less save of a name two packages hold is already refused `409` by the server, and both show that refusal; a package-less draft read is not this card.
- Serial with #28572 (PR #28747, merged first): this branch merged main after it. Data and Automations already read at the item-level package it introduced. The Interfaces leaf reads at `current.addedIn` when the pair adds the item. Without that, the merged branch failed #28572's own "an added item opens writable" case (its save went to the base).

## Verification

- The three new files plus `oneSurface-28572`: 20 of 20 passed (`--maxWorkers=2`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`).
- Every app-shell and console test file naming a touched component (`ObjectListViewInspector`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `EmbeddedItemEditor`, `MetadataDetailDrawer`, `ResourceEditPage`, the three pillars, `StudioDesignSurface`, the metadata-admin index), in locked batches of 60: at `57d352cc` (main merged at `c064d3a2`; after `pnpm install` and a rebuild of the console closure) 366 files, 2600 tests passed; at `1edfa495` (main at `8afaf12d`, which carries #28747) 365 files, 2595; at `99045462` (main at `706ac52d`) 364 files, 2583; at `797eb378`, before any merge, 363 files, 2571. CI's Test UI runs the rest of app-shell.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0 at `57d352cc`, `1edfa495`, `99045462` (65 tasks) and `797eb378`.
- ESLint on the 11 changed ts/tsx files: 0 errors (the warnings are the files' existing `react-hooks` advisories).
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 34 of 34 run, each exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` under the lock), including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`; `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Run at `57d352cc` (and earlier at `1edfa495` and `99045462`, each 34 of 34).
